9102843.plot: Yara inherits a failing orchard in the valley and, with the help of Nils, tries to keep it open for one more year.
9102843.tag: Invented tagline for The Lost Mirror.

9231866.plot: Una inherits a failing garden in Lindqvist Bay and, with the help of Soren, tries to keep it open for one more year.

9462048.plot: Wren inherits a failing ember in a small mountain town and, with the help of Noor, tries to keep it open for one more year.
9462048.tag: Invented tagline for The Pale Mirror.

9732453.plot: Elio returns to Lindqvist Bay after twenty years and finds the parade still standing, but nobody will say who keeps it running.
9732453.tag: Invented tagline for The Empty Current.

9898123.plot: Wilma inherits a failing shelter in the northern islands and, with the help of Vera, tries to keep it open for one more year.
9898123.tag: Invented tagline for The Tender Voyage.
